capabilities: Inject Chat View messages into the active note from a floating chatbox
Switch between custom roles via a dropdown
Append formatted timestamps to each message
Toggle and drag the chatbox on desktop and mobile
Configure the role list in plugin settings
disambiguation: Not a messaging or chat app integration; it only writes Chat View syntax into the active note.
extras: Manual installation only; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and mobile support is untested on iPhone.
intentEvidence: which uses the Chat View plugin by adifyr as a base
problem: Writing conversational notes with the Chat View plugin requires hand-typing its message syntax; this adds a chat interface where you pick a role and send.

relations.evidence: which uses the Chat View plugin by adifyr as a base

summary: Floating messenger-style chatbox that injects Chat View plugin syntax into the active Markdown note.
